literal: Even than a flower, it is soft, love; few people its perfect state will experience.
translation: Love is softer than a flower, but only a few ever experience its perfect state.
modern: காதல் மலரை விடவும் மிகவும் மென்மையானது. அதன் சரியான பக்குவத்தை அறிந்து அனுபவிப்பவர்கள் உலகில் சிலரே ஆவர்.
explanation: The couplet compares the nature of love to a flower, stating that love is even softer and more delicate. Because of this extreme delicacy, it requires careful and timely handling to be fully enjoyed. The word cevvi refers to the perfect state or the exact right moment of a flower blooming, which applies here to the delicate timing and understanding needed in love. Only a few people truly grasp this perfect state and experience love completely without bruising it.
